This worked walkthrough follows a single real-world customer order across **Sales**, **Inventory**, and **Accounting** so your team can verify every status transition, stock deduction, invoice posting, payment settlement, and return credit note end to end.

| Parameter | Worked Example Value | | --- | --- | | **Customer** | PT Sumber Makmur Sejahtera | | **Pricelist** | Harga Grosir (Wholesale tier) | | **Main Product** | Meja Kerja (Kayu Jati) — Storable Goods, Cost $300.00, List/Pricelist Price $450.00 | | **Quantity & Discount** | 3 Units with 5% approved volume discount ($427.50/unit, Subtotal $1,282.50, Margin $382.50 / 29.82%) | | **Optional Cross-Sell** | Kursi Kantor Ergonomis added on the **Optional Products** tab | | **Return & Refund Case** | Customer later returns 1 unit ($427.50) after full payment, settled with a partial Credit Note |

1. Open **Sales → Orders → Quotations** and click **New**. 2. Select **Customer**: PT Sumber Makmur Sejahtera. Billing/shipping addresses, salesperson, and sales team populate automatically. 3. Choose **Pricelist**: Harga Grosir. 4. On the **Order Lines** tab, click **Add a line**, choose Meja Kerja (Kayu Jati), enter **Quantity** 3, verify **Unit Price** $450.00, and enter **Discount (%)** 5. * Check the live totals at the bottom right: **Untaxed / Total = $1,282.50** and **Margin = $382.50 (29.82%)**. 5. Switch to the **Optional Products** tab and add Kursi Kantor Ergonomis so the customer can optionally include chairs. 6. Click **Save**. ERPForAll assigns reference **S00021** in **Quotation** status. ![Draft Quotation S00021 showing Harga Grosir pricelist, 3 units at 5% discount ($1,282.50), live margin ($382.50 / 29.82%), and Optional Products tab.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/quotation-draft.webp)

1. Once the customer approves the quote, click **Confirm** on S00021. 2. Verify the immediate outcomes: * Document status changes from **Quotation** to **Sales Order** (keeping number S00021). * Customer, company, and pricelist lock against accidental changes. * ERPForAll automatically creates outgoing Delivery Order **Main/OUT/00023** (Main/Stock → Customers, Demand 3) and reveals the **1 Delivery** smart button and **Create Invoice** action. ![Confirmed Sales Order S00021 with the 1 Delivery smart button and Create Invoice action ready.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/sales-order-confirmed.webp)

1. Click **1 Delivery** on S00021 (or open **Inventory → Operations → Deliveries → Main/OUT/00023**). 2. Confirm that 3 units of Meja Kerja (Kayu Jati) are reserved in **Ready** status (Main/Stock → Customers). 3. Click **Validate**. * Delivery Main/OUT/00023 transitions to **Done**. * Warehouse **On Hand** stock decreases by **3 units**. 4. Return to S00021 via the breadcrumb: the order line now shows **Delivered Qty = 3**. ![Validated Delivery Order Main/OUT/00023 in Done status confirming 3 units shipped to the customer.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/delivery-done.webp)

1. On S00021, click **Create Invoice**. 2. In the **Create Invoice** wizard, review the billing modes: * **Regular Invoice** (selected for this example — bills all 3 delivered units for $1,282.50). * **Down Payment (percentage)** or **Down Payment (fixed amount)** (useful when collecting an upfront deposit before shipping). 3. Click **Create Draft Invoice**, review the generated lines and totals ($1,282.50), and click **Confirm** to post **INV/2026/00026**. * Accounting posts **Debit Accounts Receivable $1,282.50** / **Credit Sales Revenue $1,282.50**. ![Create Invoice wizard on S00021 offering Regular Invoice and percentage or fixed-amount Down Payment options.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/create-invoice-wizard.webp)

1. On posted invoice **INV/2026/00026**, click **Register Payment**. 2. Select **Journal**: Main Bank, verify **Amount**: $1,282.50, and click **Create Payment**. 3. Verify the settled invoice: * Status badge updates to **PAID** with **Amount Due = $0.00**. * Smart buttons link directly to **1 Sales Orders** (S00021) and **1 Payments** (PBNK1/2026/00031). * Accounting posts **Debit Main Bank / Outstanding Receipts $1,282.50** / **Credit Accounts Receivable $1,282.50**. ![Settled Customer Invoice INV/2026/00026 displaying PAID status, $0.00 Amount Due, and smart buttons to S00021 and payment PBNK1/2026/00031.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/invoice-paid-linked-so.webp)

Suppose the customer returns 1 table ($427.50) after delivery and payment: 1. **Physical Return (Main/IN/00025)**: * Open completed Delivery Main/OUT/00023 and click **Return**. * ERPForAll opens Draft return receipt **Main/IN/00025** (Customers → Main/Stock). * Set the return move line **Demand** to **1**, click **Confirm**, and click **Validate** to return 1 unit into Main/Stock. 2. **Financial Refund (RINV/2026/00004)**: * Open posted invoice INV/2026/00026 and click **Credit Note**. * Choose partial refund, enter the return reason, adjust the Credit Note quantity to **1** unit ($427.50), and click **Confirm** to post **RINV/2026/00004**. * Register the outgoing refund payment (or keep the credit open to offset the customer's next invoice).

| Stage | Document Ref | Module | Stock Delta (Main/Stock) | Accounting Impact | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1. Quotation | S00021 (Draft) | Sales | 0 | None | | 2. Confirm Order | S00021 (Sales Order) | Sales | 0 (3 reserved) | None | | 3. Delivery | Main/OUT/00023 (Done) | Inventory | **-3 units** | Inventory / COGS outflow | | 4. Invoice | INV/2026/00026 (Posted) | Accounting | 0 | Dr Receivable $1,282.50 / Cr Revenue $1,282.50 | | 5. Payment | PBNK1/2026/00031 (Paid) | Accounting | 0 | Dr Bank $1,282.50 / Cr Receivable $1,282.50 | | 6a. Return Receipt | Main/IN/00025 (Done) | Inventory | **+1 unit** | Inventory / COGS reversal | | 6b. Partial Credit Note | RINV/2026/00004 (Posted) | Accounting | 0 | Dr Revenue $427.50 / Cr Receivable $427.50 | | **Net Final Position** | — | **All** | **-2 units sold** | **Net Revenue $855.00, $427.50 credit/refund** | Verify the final commercial results under **Sales → Reporting → Sales Report** and **Sales Pivot & Graph**, and confirm the posted ledger entries in **Accounting → More → Reporting → Profit and Loss** and **Partner Ledger**. ![Sales Report confirms S00021 revenue rolled up under PT Sumber Makmur Sejahtera with drill-down and export.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/sales-report.webp)

docs.title: Pricelists, Discounts, Sales Teams, Margins, and Sales Analytics

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

Commercial teams use **Pricelists**, **Discounts & Loyalty**, **Quotation Templates**, **Sales Teams**, and **Sales Reporting** to standardize pricing across customer segments, protect gross margins, and track revenue performance.

1. Open **Sales → Products → Pricelists** to inspect existing customer pricing tiers (for example, *Harga Grosir*, *Harga Pelanggan VIP*, *Reseller*, and *Harga Rupiah*). 2. Click **New** (or open a pricelist) to define: * **Currency**: Sell in local or foreign currency (using exchange rates from **Settings → Reference Data → Currencies**). * **Price Rules**: Add rules by product, variant, or category with **Minimum Quantity** thresholds, **Validity Dates**, and pricing computation (**Fixed Price**, **Percentage Discount**, or **Formula** based on public price or cost + markup). 3. Assign a default pricelist on each customer contact or pick one per quotation. ![Pricelists manage wholesale, VIP, reseller, and foreign-currency pricing tiers automatically on quotations.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/pricelists.webp)

* **Discounts & Loyalty** (**Sales → Products → Discounts & Loyalty**): Define promotional discounts, coupon codes, and loyalty rules that salespeople apply on quotations. * **Quotation Templates** (**Sales → Configuration → Quotation Templates**): Pre-configure standard product bundles, recurring service packages, validity periods, and optional cross-sell products (for example, *Office Starter Pack* or *Managed IT Support*) so reps assemble consistent quotes in seconds. * **Sales Teams** (**Sales → Configuration → Sales Teams**): Group salespeople by region, channel, or segment and assign team leaders and monthly invoicing targets. * **Sales Settings** (**Sales → Configuration → Settings**): Toggle discounts, pricelists, margins, quotation templates, lock confirmed sales, and default invoicing policy (ordered vs. delivered quantities).

Open **Sales → Reporting** to review commercial performance from three perspectives: 1. **Sales Report**: Dynamic hierarchical report summarizing confirmed sales by customer and order with period filters, comparisons, drill-down to individual orders, and PDF/XLSX export. 2. **Sales by Product**: Breaks down confirmed sales and open quotations per product so merchandising and operations can track top sellers and pipeline demand. 3. **Sales Pivot & Graph (Sales Analysis)**: Interactive multidimensional **List**, **Pivot**, and **Graph** views (Bar, Line, and Pie charts) for slicing revenue, quantities, and margins by salesperson, sales team, customer, product, or month. ![The Sales Report summarizes total sales by customer with period filters, order drill-down, and export options.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/sales-report.webp) ![Sales Pivot & Graph lets commercial leaders cross-tabulate revenue, quantities, and margins across products, teams, and periods.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/sales-pivot.webp)

* **Pricelist Rule Not Applying on Quotation**: Check the rule's **Minimum Quantity**, **Start/End Date**, and **Currency**, and make sure the product or category matches the line item. * **Crowded X-Axis on Bar Chart**: When viewing dozens of products simultaneously in **Sales Pivot & Graph → Bar Chart**, switch to **Pivot** view or group by **Product Category** or **Sales Team** for a cleaner comparison.

docs.title: Sales Quotations, Order Fulfillment, Invoicing, and Returns

sections.text: <!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 -->

The **Sales** application manages the complete **Order-to-Cash** cycle: building accurate customer quotations with pricelists, discounts, margins, and optional products, confirming sales orders into warehouse deliveries, issuing regular or down-payment invoices, and handling customer returns and credit notes.

* **Sales User (Own Documents / All Documents)**: Prepares quotations, edits draft order lines, and confirms sales orders. * **Sales Administrator**: Configures Sales Settings, Quotation Templates, Pricelists, Discounts & Loyalty, Sales Teams, and locks/unlocks confirmed orders. * **Inventory User**: Validates outgoing Delivery Orders and customer return pickings. * **Accounting User**: Runs the **Create Invoice** wizard from confirmed Sales Orders, posts Customer Invoices, registers payments, and issues Credit Notes.

1. Navigate to **Sales → Orders → Quotations** and click **New**. 2. Select the **Customer**. ERPForAll fills **Invoice Address**, **Delivery Address**, **Salesperson**, and **Sales Team** automatically. 3. Choose a **Pricelist** (for example, *Harga Grosir* or *Harga Rupiah*) and optionally apply a **Quotation Template** (configured under **Sales → Configuration → Quotation Templates**) to pre-populate recurring bundles and optional add-ons. 4. Under **Order Lines**, click **Add a line** (always pick an existing product from the dropdown list): * Set **Quantity**, verify **Unit Price** from the pricelist, and apply **Discount (%)** if approved (for example, 5%). * Review live **Subtotal**, **Tax**, **Total**, and **Margin** ($382.50 / 29.82%). 5. Optionally switch to the **Optional Products** tab to recommend cross-sell items alongside the quote. 6. Click **Save**. ERPForAll assigns a quotation number (for example, S00021). ![A Draft Quotation displays the customer, pricelist, discounted lines, live margin calculation, and Optional Products tab.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/quotation-draft.webp)

1. Review totals, delivery warehouse, and payment terms on the quotation. 2. Click **Confirm**. * The document transitions from **Quotation** to **Sales Order** while keeping its number (S00021). * For physical goods, ERPForAll automatically creates a linked outgoing transfer accessible via the **Delivery** smart button (1 Delivery). * The **Create Invoice** button becomes active for invoicing eligible lines. ![A confirmed Sales Order shows Sales Order status, the linked Delivery smart button, and the Create Invoice action.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/sales-order-confirmed.webp)

1. Click the **Delivery** smart button on the confirmed Sales Order (for example, Main/OUT/00023). 2. Verify reserved stock (ERPForAll reserves lot/serial-tracked items following FIFO rules) and confirm the **Done / Quantity** column matches the shipped units. 3. Click **Validate**. The Delivery Order transitions to **Done**, and returning to the Sales Order confirms **Delivery Quantity** updated automatically. ![A validated Delivery Order confirms goods have shipped out of warehouse stock and updates delivered quantities on the Sales Order.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/delivery-done.webp)

1. Open the completed Delivery Order (Done) and click **Return**. 2. ERPForAll creates a reverse incoming transfer (Main/IN/...) from Customers back to warehouse stock. 3. Open the stock move line to enter the returned **Demand** quantity (for example, 1 unit), click **Confirm**, and click **Validate** to return the item to inventory.

1. Open the confirmed Sales Order and click **Create Invoice** (requires Accounting access). 2. In the **Create Invoice** wizard, click the radio circle for your billing option: * **Regular Invoice**: Invoices all unbilled ordered or delivered quantities (according to each product's Invoicing Policy). * **Down Payment (percentage)**: Bills a percentage deposit (for example, 30%) ahead of delivery; later deducted automatically on the final regular invoice. * **Down Payment (fixed amount)**: Bills a fixed advance amount. 3. Click **Create Draft Invoice**, review the generated Customer Invoice (INV/...), click **Confirm** to post, and click **Register Payment** when funds arrive. 4. If the customer returned part of the shipment, open the posted invoice, click **Credit Note**, enter the return reason, adjust the refunded line quantity (for example, 1 returned unit), and post the partial Credit Note (RINV/...). ![The Create Invoice wizard supports Regular Invoices as well as percentage or fixed-amount Down Payments directly from the Sales Order.](/en/next/assets/docs/assets/user-manual/sales/create-invoice-wizard.webp)

* **Inline Product Search Error (Missing required field 'Name')**: When adding a line, always select a product from the dropdown suggestions rather than pressing **Enter** on blank text. * **Down Payment Field Not Expanding**: In the **Create Invoice** wizard, click directly on the circular radio button next to *Down Payment (percentage)* or *Down Payment (fixed amount)* to reveal the percentage/amount input. * **Cancelling a Confirmed Sales Order**: Cancel any open outgoing **Delivery** transfer first before cancelling the Sales Order. For a complete worked walkthrough with real document numbers, stock movements, and accounting entries, see [Sales Full-Cycle Example: Order-to-Cash End-to-End](/en/next/user/sales-full-cycle-example.md).
